title: QB5_B#q8 taught a third, different MACN membership figure and an unsourced share of global tonnage
candidate_claim: Raised by production. H4 expanded the MACN identity card QB5_E#q4 for AUG-0195 and corrected its membership figure from '150+' to MACN's own 'over 225 members across more than 45 countries'. Verifying my own claim that the sibling cards carried no stale figure showed that claim was FALSE.
rationale: QB5_B#q8 taught 'Scale 200+ member companies, >50% of global tonnage, active in 50+ countries'. With QB5_E#q4 corrected to 225/45+, the corpus would have asserted THREE different membership figures for one organisation across three MACN cards. MACN's own site states 'Over 225' members 'Across Over 45' countries. No share-of-global-tonnage figure appears on the MACN pages read; that limb is unsourced and is removed rather than restated.
note: WHY THIS IS A CORRECTION AND NOT PART OF THE BATCH. QB5_B#q8 was shipped by an earlier batch and is not an AUG-0195 target - the adjudication named QB5_E#q4 and QB1_B#q9 and missed this card entirely. A batch closes when it publishes, so a repair to someone else's shipped card gets its own record. QB1_B#q9 was checked and carries no membership figure, so it is untouched.
authority: macn.dk front page and About page, read 2026-09-01. Registered as SRC-MACN-2026-09.

cards.rationale: The Scale row now gives MACN's own figure with its date and an explicit instruction not to quote a tonnage share.

propagation: Sweep for membership figures across all three MACN cards. QB5_E#q4 corrected under batch H4 (150+ -> 225/45+), QB5_B#q8 corrected here (200+/tonnage/50+ -> 225/45+), QB1_B#q9 carries no figure. QB5_E_cheatsheet.html carries the corrected figure. No other card in the 86-file bank states a MACN membership count.

invariants.new_cards_note: The three new cards belong to batch_h4_manifest.json; both share baseline bd7e076.

review.round_1_verdict: Independently confirmed: a reviewer read macn.dk and reported 'Over 225' members across 'Over 45' countries, and separately flagged that the card claims no tonnage share it can support.
review.producer_verification: The producer found the QB5_B#q8 contradiction before the reviewers reported, while re-checking a claim made in the H4 manifest.
